$comment: The Node.js runtime bundled with the desktop app for the command line tool (apps/cli). Electron's own Node (24.x) is not used: the CLI needs node:ffi, which arrived in Node 26.1 and is not in Electron's build. Digests come from https://nodejs.org/dist/<version>/SHASUMS256.txt. Change the version here, nowhere else. It must satisfy apps/cli/package.json engines.node.
